newsitem.title: USA: Firm zinc premiums offered in U.S. Mint tender.
newsitem.headline: Firm zinc premiums offered in U.S. Mint tender.

text.p: Premiums on likely winners in the U.S. Mint zinc tender confirmed the healthy state of the domestic market, traders said.
The U.S. Mint was looking to buy 2,499 tonnes of special high grade metal, and five companies stepped up to the plate, Hochschild, Trademet, Bal, Ore & Chemical (MG), and Midland.
Hochschild looked set to sell 1,056 tonnes and Trademet 844 tonnes to Alltrista location at premiums of 5.45 to 5.97 cents per pound above LME cash.
Trademet, Bal and Ore & Chemical were the likely winners to sell a total of 599 tonnes, split roughly equal between the three, to the La Salle location at premiums of 5.15 to 5.99 cents per pound.
"Zinc is in good shape," one of the winning sellers said.
The Mint tender will underpin the current level of premiums in the market at 5.25 to 5.75 cents per pound, traders said.
